name: Segmented
description:
**Overview:** A horizontal strip of mutually exclusive toggle buttons for switching between views, modes, or short option sets.

**Use Cases:**
- ✅ Use for view mode switching (List / Grid / Map), time period selection (Day / Week / Month), or alignment controls.
- ✅ Use when there are 2–5 options and only one can be active at a time.
- ❌ DO NOT use for page-to-page navigation — use Tabs or Sidebar.
- ❌ DO NOT use with more than 5 options — use a Select/Dropdown instead.

**Props / Variants:** Items (2–5), Selected Index, Size, Icon/Text/Icon+Text.

**Original Notes:** Mutually exclusive button group for view-switching and compact option selection.

name: Toggle
description:
**Overview:** A switch control used to instantly turn a setting on or off.

**Use Cases:**
- ✅ Use for immediate settings (e.g., Dark Mode, Notifications).
- ❌ DO NOT use in a form that requires a final 'Submit' button to save.

**Props / Variants:** Size, State, Select, Theme.

**Original Notes:** Binary switches used to immediately activate or deactivate a setting.

name: Toggle-Button
description: Binary switches used to immediately activate or deactivate a setting.

name: Badge
description:
**Overview:** A compact label used to indicate status, category, or type at a glance. Typically applied to content items in tables, cards, or lists.

**Use Cases:**
- ✅ Use to show record status (Active, Pending, Rejected, Archived).
- ✅ Use to tag content with a category or attribute (e.g., "Design", "Bug", "High Priority").
- ❌ DO NOT use for notification counts — use Badge-Counter instead.
- ❌ DO NOT use for long labels or sentences; keep text to 1–2 words max.

**Props / Variants:** Type (Soft/Solid), Theme (Success, Warning, Error, Info, Neutral), Size, Leading Icon, Dot.

**Original Notes:** Small visual indicators for status, category, or attribute labels.

name: Badge-Counter
description:
**Overview:** A numeric overlay indicator for unread counts or pending notification numbers, typically placed on icons or avatars.

**Use Cases:**
- ✅ Use on navigation items to show unread messages, pending tasks, or alert counts.
- ✅ Use overlaid on avatars, bell icons, or tab items in toolbars.
- ❌ DO NOT use for status labels — use Badge instead.
- ❌ DO NOT display exact counts above 99 — truncate to "99+" to maintain compact sizing.

**Props / Variants:** Count, Size, Position (Top-Right/Top-Left).

**Original Notes:** Small numeric overlays for notification counts.

name: Avatar/Stack
description:
**Overview:** Displays a stacked group of avatars, indicating multiple users.

**Use Cases:**
- ✅ Use for project members, chat groups, or document viewers.
- ❌ DO NOT use when individual names must be highly visible.

**Props / Variants:** More (+N count), Size, Background, Number.

**Original Notes:** Visual representations of users, bots, or groups using images or initials.

name: .Primitives/Avatar/Status/XSmall/Disabled
description: Visual representation of a user, team, or entity.
